description: A computable certificate checker whose certified theorem codes are sound for full second-order arithmetic semantics cannot be weakly complete.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.no_complete_checker (check : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (hc : Computable₂ check)
  (hS :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.Sound
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.Certified check)) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.WeaklyComplete
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.Certified check)
